  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_17(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (len == 0) {\n    return VERA_ERR;\n  }\n  uint64_t count = 0;\n  uint64_t total_length = 0;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    if (in[i] == '\\0') {\n      break;\n    }\n    if (len < i + 2) {\n      return VERA_ERR;\n    }\n    uint8_t char_length = in[i + 1];\n    if (len < i + 2 + char_length) {\n      return VERA_ERR;\n    }\n    count++;\n    total_length += char_length;\n    i += 2 + char_length;\n  }\n  if (count <= out_cap) {\n    out[0] = (uint8_t)(count >> 32);\n    out[1] = (uint8_t)(count >> 24);\n    out[2] = (uint8_t)(count >> 16);\n    out[3] = (uint8_t)(count >> 8);\n    out[4] = (uint8_t)total_length;\n    out[5] = (uint8_t)(total_length >> 8);\n    out[6] = (uint8_t)(total_length >> 16);\n    out[7] = (uint8_t)(total_length >> 24);\n    return count << 32 | total_length;\n  }\n  return VERA_ERR;\n}"
}
